title: Kingdom Come Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Feel like the king of your vacation in this LIKE NEW beach house minutes from downtown Seaside. Kingdom Come is a renovated 3 bedroom/ 3.5 bath cottage with heated pool and gulf views….all for ½ the price of your traditional Seaside cottage!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - GREAT location in OLD SEAGROVE, walking distance to the town of Seaside and steps to the beach at HICKORY St. - Private heated pool - TVs in all bedrooms - Short walk into Seaside, shopping and restaurants - Gas grill - Private driveway - Fully stocked kitchen - Fun, coastal and colorful decor - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) -Pool heat in the off season- $300 to heat Kingdom Come sleeps 10 comfortably. The first floor boasts a modern living area, open dining space, and a large, fully equipped kitchen to prepare wonderful meals. A half bath & a twin bedroom with a full bathroom complete the first floor of your home away from home. The regal King master bedroom with TV is housed on the second floor boasting a master bath with shower & a whirlpool bath. The floor is rounded out by a queen bedroom with a full bath, a TV, and a fabulous screened-in porch, a perfect place for your morning coffee! Two additional bunk beds (twin over full) are tucked into an alcove that kids just love. If entertaining is your thing, the third floor is perfect for you! Complete with a wet-bar, seating area and flat screen TV, it’s a beautiful spot to kick back and enjoy cocktails and a board game inside or a sunset view from the spacious patio with a partial ocean view. ACCOMMODATIONS (Sleeps 10): Bedroom 1: King master suite / private en suite with jacuzzi tub and separate shower, TV with Cable and streaming capabilities Bedroom 2: Queen / private en suite with bath/shower combo, TV Bedroom 3: Twins (2) / private en suite with bath/shower combo, TV Bunk bed (twin over full) in open alcove hallway . Futon available on the third floor in the tower- sleeps 1 comfortably or 2 small kids LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!! Nestled in Old Seagrove Beach, just a few minutes from downtown Seaside, Kingdom Come is in the ideal location for a short stroll into town and an even shorter walk to the Beach Access!!! The beautifully landscaped yard includes a heated pool, large paver sunning deck with lounge chairs, and a teak dining set complete with a large sun umbrella . This backyard all is surrounded by a 6 foot privacy fence. The space is complete with a large gas grill, a private back deck and an outdoor shower. The front porch is a special area for hanging out in lazy Adirondack chairs. * Sorry, no pets allowed. * Parking for 2 cars in private driveway ** There is a $300 charge to heat the pool. ** FREE WIFI

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
